test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given graph shows the number of students who passed SSC in two institutes (P and Q) during four years.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7aaade326fc5317afb1b61c6dae44d5d6b007ab3c0c8e3aad42ab26008a9f51.png] 

What is the difference between the average number of students who passed in institute P in 2015 and 2016 and that in institute Q in 2017 and 2018?
solution:
**Formula Used:**

 Average = frac{{Sum of observation}}{{Total observation}}

**Calculation:**

According to the question

The average number of students who passed institute P in 2015 and 2016 is

Average1 = (200+250)/(2)=(450)/(2) = 225

Average number of students who passed institute Q in 2017 and 2018 is

Average2 = (150+50)/(2)=(200)/(2) = 100

The difference between the average will be

⇒ Average1 - Average2

⇒ 225 - 100 = 125

**The difference between the average number of students who passed institute P in 2015 and 2016 and that in institute Q in 2017 and 2018 is 125.**
